mapper.insert: insert into orders (order_no, user_id, merchant_id, total_amount, total_calorie, order_type, status, remark, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{merchantId}, #{totalAmount}, #{totalCalorie}, #{orderType}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.merchant_id, o.total_amount, o.total_calorie, o.order_type, o.status, o.pickup_code, o.pay_time, o.accept_time, o.finish_time, o.remark, o.create_time, o.update_time, u.nickname userNickname, m.name merchantName from orders o left join user u on o.user_id = u.id left join merchant m on o.merchant_id = m.id where o.id = #{id}
mapper.update: update orders set status = #{status}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
